dedupe_keys.name: carta della pericolosita sismica della regione umbria

description: Carta della Pericolosità Sismica della Regione Umbria is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by regione.umbria.it. Map of regional seismic hazards scale 1:250,000 containing the values of point ag at the top of the grid, with a return time 475 years and the seismic classification of the territory in force. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Map of the Sismic Dangerousness of the Umbria Region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Pericolosità sismica, Zona sismica. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
